settings.text: About the book, the files and refunds. Anything else, write to us and you will hear back within two working days.

settings.question: What format is the book in?
settings.answer: You get a PDF and an EPUB. The PDF is laid out for reading on a laptop or printing. The EPUB works on phones, tablets and most e-readers.

settings.question: How do I get it?
settings.answer: The download links are on the confirmation page and in your receipt email, a minute after you pay. They stay in your account too.

settings.question: Do I need to be good with computers?
settings.answer: No. If you can send an email and take a photo with your phone, you can follow every chapter.

settings.question: Will this work outside the US?
settings.answer: Yes. The map listings and review sites in the book work the same way in most countries. Where something differs, the book says so.

settings.question: What if it is not for me?
settings.answer: Write within 30 days and you get your money back. No form to fill in.

settings.question: Can I read it on a Kindle?
settings.answer: Yes. Send the EPUB to your Kindle with Send to Kindle and it appears in your library within a few minutes.

settings.question: Is the workbook a separate file?
settings.answer: Yes. The bundle adds a printable PDF with every exercise and checklist on its own page, ready to fill in by hand.

settings.question: Can I share it with my staff?
settings.answer: One copy covers everyone working in the same business. For a group or a class, write to us about a team licence.

settings.question: Will there be a new edition?
settings.answer: When search changes enough to matter. Buyers of this edition get the updates to it for free.

settings.note: One email a month with a short tip. Unsubscribe any time.
settings.success_text: Thanks. Chapter one is on its way.
